descriptions.w3d_s20_classify_item_bytes_801d5844: Appears to set a mode on the secondary base to 1 when blocked, else 0, 1 or 2 from the alpha bytes of an item's records (255 neutral, 0 partial).
descriptions.w3d_s20_find_value_801a688c: Appears to look up an unsigned key in an ordered tree at offset 76 and return the stored value, or 0 when the key is absent.
